checks.observation: Offline embedded bootstrap is verified by UpdateService; GetActiveDirectoryAsync verifies active version files before fixed Talos.App.dll load. Only fixed Talos.Core/Talos.App assembly resolution from that version directory is added. Updates remains host shared. No arbitrary plugin-directory scanning is present.

Native ECDSA P-256 verifies SHA-256 over exact decoded payload bytes with 64-byte IEEE-P1363 signatures. Manifest schema/duplicates, entry identity, lengths/hashes and file list are validated. Install reauthenticates its immutable manifest envelope.

Update HTTP calls are confined to CheckAsync and InstallAsync. Host startup bootstrap, StatusAsync, RollbackAsync and GetActiveDirectoryAsync only read/verify local data. App screenshots and advice do not reference HTTP or a Python/Node subprocess. Explicit update restart launches only the supplied fixed host path without a shell.

Reviewed file locks, staged complete file extraction, member whitelist, per-file hashing, Windows path/device/ADS aliases, symlink/reparse rejection, expansion bounds, atomic state replacement, healthy rollback and repair-backup restoration. This is source review; executable update cases are owned by Talos.Tests.

Unknown rooms, invalid controller fields, unsupported flags and scratch state cannot bypass manual confirmation. Field/source changes invalidate recommendations. Import/capture/recognition/advice workers compare revision or cancellation identity before applying results; failed capture cannot automatically recognize the previous image.

Capture reads the selected client-area screen rectangle or selected monitor using BitBlt; it does not click the game. Minimized/lost windows and oversized dimensions reject. Per-monitor DPI context is restored and GDI objects are released. F8 registration is removed on close. GetDIBits now runs after unselecting its bitmap.

findingsResolvedByOwners.finding: GetDIBits was called with the bitmap selected into a DC.
findingsResolvedByOwners.resolution: Owner now unselects after BitBlt, reads using the screen DC, and requires all scan lines.

findingsResolvedByOwners.finding: Failed image import preserved old advice; asynchronous import/capture lacked generation guards.
findingsResolvedByOwners.resolution: Owner invalidates before acquisition and checks revision before applying delayed images.

findingsResolvedByOwners.finding: Failed capture could automatically re-recognize the previous screenshot.
findingsResolvedByOwners.resolution: Owner recognizes only the successfully added current image from that capture.

findingsResolvedByOwners.finding: Capture-source changes did not invalidate prior advice.
findingsResolvedByOwners.resolution: Owner now resets image, board and suggestions when the selected source changes.

findingsResolvedByOwners.finding: Old repair directory moved to backup could remain displaced if staging publish failed before the published flag.
findingsResolvedByOwners.resolution: Owner had independently fixed the branch; final cleanup now restores backup whenever uncommitted and target is absent, independent of published.

limitations: Linux source review and .NET console strategy execution do not establish Windows WPF startup, native hotkey, screenshot, high-DPI or overlay rendering success.
BitBlt reads visible screen pixels; occluding windows or protected/exclusive rendering can affect the captured client-area image. Manual review remains required.
No live Chinese game OCR accuracy, full-game return, global-optimality or training claim is supported by this audit.
No update private key was read, no Windows PE was executed, and no external repository was modified by this audit.
